DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The clinical picture of sudden, position-dependent spinning vertigo in a 70-year-old without hearing loss or neurological deficits is classic for BPPV. While you requested a specific output, my clinical assessment based on the Dix-Hallpike maneuver and history strongly points to BPPV, not migraine.
